errors.enterServer: Enter a server address, like example.social.
errors.notRegistered: This server didn't register the app. Check the address and try again.
errors.notApproved: Your server didn't approve the sign-in. Try again.
errors.linkExpired: This sign-in link has expired. Start again from the sign-in screen.
errors.notVerified: This sign-in couldn't be verified. Start again from the sign-in screen.
errors.enterPds: Enter a server address, like pds.example.com.
errors.pdsNotFound: Couldn't find the server for {{identifier}}. Check the handle and try again.
errors.handleNeeded: Enter your handle. Add the server address below.
errors.wrongPasswordSelfHosted: Wrong handle or password. Self-hosted servers may want your account password instead of an app password.
errors.unreachable: Couldn't reach {{server}}. Check the address or leave it empty to find your server from your handle.
errors.unreachableOauth: Couldn't reach {{server}}. Check the handle or address and try again.
errors.unreachableGeneric: Couldn't reach your server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.clientRejected: This server doesn't accept Sowocial's sign-in. Sign in with a password instead.
errors.scopeRejected: This server refused the permissions Sowocial asks for. Sign in with a password instead.

login.headline: Sign in to your server.
login.intro: GoToSocial, Mastodon, Akkoma and other servers with the Mastodon API. You approve access on your server's own page.
login.blueskyIntro: Sign in with your Bluesky handle, or the address of your own PDS. You approve access on your server's sign-in page.
login.blueskyPasswordIntro: Sign in with an app password or your account password. Some servers, including many self-hosted ones, don't offer app passwords.
login.usePassword: Sign in with a password instead
login.useOAuth: Sign in with your server's page instead
